title: Pre-FOMC Uncertainty Accumulation: Evidence from 0DTE Options
summary: Owned VIX/VXN daily closes do not supply the SPX0DTE surface. Treat as source counterevidence, not a new pre-FOMC rescue or generic-VIX proxy.
about: Pre-FOMC uncertainty measured with same-day options.
findings: Abstract argues uncertainty accumulates and reports disappearance of pre-FOMC drift after Wednesday0DTE introduction; no independent replication.
mechanism: A changing compensation/hedging environment may affect premia; uncertainty accumulation alone has no signed futures payoff.
build_on: Owned VIX/VXN daily closes do not supply the SPX0DTE surface. Treat as source counterevidence, not a new pre-FOMC rescue or generic-VIX proxy.
